admin.confirm_deactivate: Deactivate this user? Their sessions will be revoked.
integrity.stale: Inputs changed. Recalculate before saving these results.
integrity.incomplete: Comparison incomplete. Aggregate cost savings are unavailable.
integrity.legacy: Legacy scenario: calculation provenance is unverified.
integrity.staffing_basis: Staffing totals assume one-hour segments; requirements are not employee schedules. Savings include modeled waiting and abandonment costs.
integrity.simulation_coverage: DES and Monte Carlo cover M/M/1 and M/M/c only. Other queueing models are not validated by these simulations.
integrity.unsupported: Simulation unsupported; no validation claim is available.
integrity.erlang_basis: Erlang-A W/Wq are legacy workload-per-served-throughput ratios, not mean waits for all arrivals or served customers.
system.no_feasible: No staffing plan satisfies all enabled constraints, including the wait limit when set.
system.staffing_unavailable: Staffing totals are unavailable until every segment has a current, feasible recommendation.
system.save_incomplete: You can save this calculation with its warnings. Aggregate savings remain unavailable when the current baseline or optimized plan is incomplete or unstable.
system.max_wait: Maximum analytical wait in minutes (blank disables limit)
system.simulation_basis: DES results are simulated, not observed. The planning target does not guarantee that realized utilization stays below it in every interval.
system.mc_basis: Monte Carlo uses analytical sensitivity trials, not repeated DES. Independent uniform variations of arrivals ±20% and service rates ±10% are assumptions. Failure means utilization exceeds the selected threshold; the default allowed failure rate is 5%. Intervals use 95% Wilson confidence.
system.analytical_basis: Analytical estimates from the selected model, not observed outcomes. Service variance is in hours squared; theta is a patience rate per hour.
system.cost_basis: Costs and abandonment percentages are configured assumptions. Abandonment percentage is a sensitivity scenario, not Erlang-A patience rate or measured customer loss.
